question: Compare the role of refraction in image formation by a lens and deviation of light by a prism. Give reason for the difference in their effects.

options.A: A lens and a prism have identical effects because both have plane parallel refracting surfaces.
options.B: A lens has curved refracting surfaces, so refraction at them can make rays converge or diverge to form an image. A prism has inclined plane faces, so refraction mainly produces angular deviation and dispersion.
options.C: A prism forms images while a lens only disperses light because a prism has a larger refractive index.
options.D: A lens and a prism both produce only lateral displacement without changing the direction of rays.
